scope: BLAKE3 update only native, cache disabled, standard production proof and search budgets. No runtime timing claim.

diagnosis.cause: The push_chunk call summary writes 4-byte cv leaves, while the other arm copies 8-byte words. mergeTwo retained only equal-address, equal-width frame slots, losing all eight common fields. bodyEnd.valueOfVar then substituted the fresh header value for each absent slot, so invariant pruning removed the changed fields.
baseline_diagnostic_example: CV inventory event=1 name=s1099511627776:4 bound=true value=state.cv[0]
CV next event=1 name=s1099511627776:4 fresh=true header=false value=loop1.s1099511627776:4
CV end event=1 name=s1099511627776:4 end=0 known=false unknown=<nil> value=<nil>
diagnosis.fix: Intersect disjoint sorted byte ranges at joins, select each common piece under the branch condition, and refuse a loop summary when a carried frame value is absent. Gaps remain unknown; invalid or overlapping incoming frame layouts do not merge.

coupling_preparation.issue: Restoring changed fields exposed repeated substitution and dependency walks through large call-result expressions at intervening search depths.
coupling_preparation.fix: Cache machine-symbol dependencies of source terms and coupling replacements. Defer preliminary valuations until both sets are paired; retain the post-substitution dependency check and all complete candidate proofs.
coupling_preparation.semantics: Substitution replaces a parameter once. Dependency checks inspect replacement names without recursively substituting them. Rolled-back pairings are checked against the current substitution map.
stopped_experiments: The initial frame-only emission was stopped after more than ten minutes in repeated coupling preparation.
Caching only raw source dependencies still repeated work when a replacement introduced another unpaired symbol; the superseded runs were stopped.
coupling_preparation.final_emission_before_last_rebase: Completed successfully with the normal witness verdict and unchanged native object.
coupling_preparation.timing_scope: One final compiler-emission run after integration, under concurrent host load; not a runtime benchmark or a controlled compile-time comparison.

reduced_regression.before: Witness evidence on 152 inputs; no preserving pairing for the high word.

selection.reason: the coupling search exceeded its budget
